en: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph of a group of men hiking in a wooded, hilly area. The men are dressed in early 20th-century outdoor attire, including knee breeches, sweaters, and flat caps, and several are carrying walking sticks. The setting appears to be a forest or mountainous terrain during fall or early spring, as there are no leaves on the trees and the ground is covered in dry leaves.
